About Harbor Mortgage Advice

Rachel and Tom provide whole-of-market advice with clear communication from first call to completion.

Harbor Mortgage Advice is an independent firm based on Tombland in Norwich. We are not tied to any high-street bank.

Principal adviser Rachel holds CeMAP qualifications and explains options in plain English—fixed vs variable, porting, and affordability—without jargon.
